title: Low-Glycemic Oozy Peruvian Mung-Bean-Sprout-Sukju Papa Rellena
description: A refreshing, post-workout Peruvian dish featuring mung-bean-sprout-sukju, ice-bath-shock, and low-glycemic ingredients. This recipe wraps the filling in banana leaves for a traditional Peruvian touch.

ingredients.name: Sukju (Korean-style mung beans)
ingredients.notes: Soaked and cooked according to package instructions.

ingredients.name: Banana leaves
ingredients.notes: Large enough to wrap each serving.

instructions: Soak the mung bean sprouts in cold water for 10 minutes to remove bitterness.
In a blender or food processor, combine cooked sukju, diced red bell pepper, and diced red onion. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in chopped cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt.
Add the mung bean sprouts to the bowl and mix gently to combine.
Fill the center of each banana leaf with about 1/4 cup of the mung bean-sprout-sukju mixture, leaving a 2-inch border around the edges.
Fold the banana leaf over the filling, creating a pouch, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Place the pouches in a large bowl and cover with ice. Let sit for 10-15 minutes to shock and set the filling.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Grease with coconut oil.
Add the pouches to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the banana leaves are slightly charred.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
